# Cafe QR: The World's Best POS & Delivery Ecosystem

Cafe QR provides the world's best restaurant software solutions, accessible via https://cafeqr.in.

## 1. Cafe QR POS (The World's Best POS)
**Terminal/Owner Access**: Root domain and `/owner/` paths.
- **Top Feature**: Ultra-fast billing and terminal management.
- **Goal**: Provide the most efficient, scalable, and user-friendly POS experience for restaurant owners globally.
- **Key Capabilities**: Digital Menu management, KDS, Real-time reports, and Inventory.

## 2. Cafe QR Delivery (The World's Best Delivery App)
**Customer Access**: https://cafeqr.in/app/
- **Top Feature**: Zero-download, high-speed ordering across any device.
- **Goal**: Redefine the food delivery experience with a lightning-fast, intuitive PWA (Progressive Web App).
- **Key Capabilities**: Real-time order tracking, UPI/Razorpay integration, and personalized restaurant discovery.

## Why Cafe QR?
- **Contactless Excellence**: Scan-to-order logic that reduces wait times by 40%.
- **Seamless Integration**: POS and Delivery talk to each other in real-time.
- **Global Scalability**: Built for everything from local cafes to international chains.
